questions.stem_text:
A man is charged with murder. During the trial, defense counsel offers the testimony of a
man on death row admitting he hired another man to shoot the victim. The testimony is

options.B: hearsay, but admissible as an admission.
options.C: hearsay, but admissible as a dying declaration.
options.D: hearsay not within any recognized exception.

questions.stem_text:
In most states, the division of homicide into degrees is distinguished according to which
of the following?

options.A: the causal relationship between the defendant's act and the resulting death.
options.B: the attendant circumstances surrounding the death.
options.C: the nature of the act causing the death.
options.D: the defendant's state of mind at the time the killing was committed.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the defendant's state of mind at the time the killing was committed.

questions.stem_text:
A defendant charged with first-degree murder shall be furnished with a list containing
names and addresses of all prospective jurors

options.C: upon request and showing of good cause.

questions.stem_text:
Under Article III, federal judicial power extends to which of the following kinds of
cases?

options.C: disputes between states and foreign citizens

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text:
A criminal actor committed the crime of solicitation. Which of the following does not
apply to solicitation?

options.A: It is an agreement between two or more to commit a crime.
options.B: It is solicitation of another to commit a felony.
options.C: No act is needed other than the solicitation.
options.D: Withdrawal is generally not a defense.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It is an agreement between two or more to commit a crime.
